source: P00_FOUNDATION_SPECIFICATION.md §10 (statements verbatim). p00_refs are resolved mechanically by scripts/validate-specs.ts: 'path' must exist; 'path#text' must exist and contain the text (a test title).

invariants.statement: Models cannot directly execute external side effects.
p00_refs: tests/contract/extension-contracts.test.ts#a model tool call is a proposal only
tests/contract/no-authority.test.ts#node code (graph + schemas, transitively) imports only side-effect-free modules
invariants.notes: ModelAdapter exposes generate/stream only; tool calls are ToolCallProposal data.

invariants.statement: Tool execution must pass through the capability gateway.
p00_refs: tests/contract/extension-contracts.test.ts#fails closed for unknown capabilities and invalid arguments
invariants.notes: P00 registry validates, times out and fails closed; the full gateway is P05.

invariants.statement: Consequential actions require policy evaluation.
p00_refs: tests/integration/langgraph-postgres.test.ts#executes, streams, and records the run lifecycle
invariants.notes: ProposedAction/PolicyDecision contracts and a recorded demo decision; the policy engine is P06.

invariants.statement: Permissions are enforced outside prompts.
invariants.notes: Scopes and allowed/denied capabilities are structured contract data, not prompt text.

invariants.statement: Every agent has finite resource limits.
p00_refs: tests/contract/extension-contracts.test.ts#scaling decisions are checked against declared limits

invariants.statement: Every child agent belongs to a root run and parent lineage.
p00_refs: packages/contracts/test/records.test.ts#enforces parent lineage within one root run

invariants.statement: Important state-changing operations emit durable events.
p00_refs: tests/integration/postgres.test.ts#records events durably in order with causation links

invariants.statement: Artifacts carry provenance and integrity hashes.
Completion follows verification policy.
invariants.notes: verification_policy is mandatory on AgentSpec and Task; verification behaviour is P09.

invariants.statement: Secrets do not enter ordinary prompt context.
p00_refs: packages/contracts/test/records.test.ts#rejects raw secret values in secret scope
packages/config/test/config.test.ts#never includes secret values in errors or serialised config
packages/observability/test/redaction.test.ts#never writes a secret-like value passed by mistake
invariants.notes: Typed SecretRef in contracts; SecretString in config; redacting logger.

invariants.statement: Cancellation must eventually propagate to owned execution.
p00_refs: tests/contract/extension-contracts.test.ts#enforces the declared timeout and output schema
invariants.notes: AbortSignal is part of the model and capability ports; end-to-end cancellation propagation is a later phase.

invariants.statement: Unknown execution outcome is not automatically treated as failure.
p00_refs: tests/failure/p00-failures.test.ts#F03 database disconnect during the test workflow
invariants.notes: A connection lost mid-workflow (event log or checkpoint store) records run status UNKNOWN, not FAILED (F03).

invariants.statement: Untrusted content cannot become trusted instruction implicitly.
invariants.notes: Context messages and extension metadata carry an explicit trust level.

invariants.statement: Self-improvement cannot silently rewrite security authority.
invariants.notes: No self-improvement exists in P00 (non-goal); owned by P17.

invariants.statement: Human denial overrides agent intent.
p00_refs: tests/contract/extension-contracts.test.ts#human denial overrides; policy DENY cannot be approved away

invariants.statement: Model implementations are replaceable behind contracts.
No agent receives unrestricted system access by default.
p00_refs: tests/contract/no-authority.test.ts#runtime adapter (transitively) reaches only the harness-owned checkpoint store
tests/contract/extension-contracts.test.ts#refuses to register any capability with side effects in P00

invariants.statement: Autonomous actions are auditable.
p00_refs: tests/integration/langgraph-postgres.test.ts#executes, streams, and records the run lifecycle
invariants.notes: Durable causal event chain with trace/correlation IDs; full audit trail grows with later phases.

invariants.statement: Context fragments have provenance.
invariants.notes: ContextMessage requires provenance {source, trust}; the context compiler is P04.

invariants.statement: Unknown authority/state fails safely.
